description: Certification of the ukg-derived structure built with three_d/rcsr_net.py (origin choice 2, struts from the EDGE_CENTER records), run with the fixed_raster (cubic voxels, k = 1-3, and its mirror image), junction (original c/a, k = 1-2) and insulating (insulating matrix) stages. The certified intervals contain zero, so ukg is not used as a certified example; the atlas point estimate is in three_d/rcsr_color_N16_all.json.
